question: What power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is the object of continual contemplation.
The resulting power affects the triple world.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The exact object that is smoke-colored is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating what is smoke-colored, one can shake the triple world.
